name: European option prices
prompt: Use Black-Scholes to price a European call and put with spot 120, strike 110, annual risk-free rate 0.03, annual volatility 0.25, maturity 0.75 years, and no dividends. Return only a JSON object with numeric call and put fields, rounded to two decimals.

name: Currency conversion after a fee
prompt: Convert EUR 1250 to USD at 1.08375 USD per EUR, then deduct a 0.4% fee from the converted USD amount. Return only a JSON object with a numeric netUsd field, rounded to two decimals.
